# ExpandableSections

ExpandableSections is a Panel-derived collection control that presents authored SectionItem records as retained expandable headers over caller-owned content controls; per-section expansion may borrow a Value\<bool\> model, single-open mode is optional, and toggles publish the section index and new state.
